description:
Every business of ONE trade (`niche`: a key from list_niches, exactly) near `location`, default radius 15 miles, 20 a page.
The order is fixed and is not a ranking: independent businesses, then chains, then marketplaces; inside each, by distance (a trade that comes to the customer: published service area first).
`query` does NOT filter or reorder businesses: it chooses which ITEM each card shows. To find businesses that have an item, use search_catalog.
Each card: id, name, distance, phone, a few items, `next` (one action), and for what you pass — `needed_by`, `max_price`, `deliver_to` — a state: hours give open_then / closed_then / unknown (never a free slot); an item price within the budget is item_price_within_budget (the total is not known until priced).
`needed_by`: «today», «tomorrow 19:00», «after 15:00», an interval «tomorrow 08:00 to 17:00», a deadline «by 2026-11-20», a range «this week» — read the same way in every tool.
A `niche` that is not a key returns no cards and the variants to choose from.

deliver_to.description: where it must be brought (a postcode is best): adds can_deliver_to per card — confirmed when the published area names the place, refuted when the business says no, unknown otherwise

detail.description: task (default): the short card under the task; shelf: the older ≤ 1 KB shelf card

intent.description: what the user means to do: shapes the items shown and the ONE action in `next` (book → book / check_slot / call; order → order / quote_order / call; quote → quote_order / call; info → call)

location.description: a 5-digit US postcode (best), a city ("Tampa, FL") or "lat,lng". Required: the shelf is a place.

max_price.description: the most for ONE offering, in USD: groups the cards in_budget · budget_unknown · over_budget (nobody is left out) and picks the shown offering inside it (exact, then kind, then partial matches); fixed prices compare; a «from» price above the budget is over, under it budget_unknown

needed_by.description: when: «sunday» / «today» / «2026-11-08» (open that day), «tomorrow 19:00» / «now» (open at that minute), «after 15:00» / «tomorrow after 3pm» (open after then; a free slot only where the source knows slots) — on each business’s own clock; adds `time` {asked_as, day, hours, state, why} and LEAVES OUT only the cards refuted for the way the trade is done (see excluded)

niche.description: a niche key from list_niches, exactly (another word returns the variants to choose from, never a substitute)

page.description: the `next_page` token of the previous answer

properties.description: facts to read off each card without filtering: property_states {key: "confirmed <value>" | "refuted" | "unknown"}

query.description: chooses which ITEM each card shows («red roses», «balayage»); it does not filter or reorder businesses — for that, search_catalog

tags.description: FILTER by the niche’s own tags, as list_niches gives them («steak house», «italian», «dish»): a card without one of them is left out; the order does not change. Spelling is folded («steakhouse» = «steak house»).
